name: Joel
summary: A prophet, the son of Pethuel, to whom the word of the LORD came. When locusts stripped the land, he called the people to fast and turn back to the LORD with all their heart.

key_moments.title: Mourns the Land the Locusts Ate
key_moments.description: Joel called the old men to hear what had come on the land: swarm after swarm of insects had eaten it bare. He told the priests to put on sackcloth, call a fast and gather everyone into the house of the LORD to cry to Him.

key_moments.title: Tells Judah to Rend Their Hearts
key_moments.description: Joel warned that the day of the LORD was near, a day of darkness. He called the people to turn to the LORD with fasting and weeping, and to rend their hearts and not their garments, for the LORD is gracious and merciful.

key_moments.title: Says God Will Pour Out His Spirit
key_moments.description: Joel said the LORD would give back the years the locust had eaten. Afterward He would pour out His spirit on all flesh, sons and daughters would prophesy, and whoever called on the name of the LORD would be delivered.
